text: Intaglio side implemented: opt-in PanelFraming.markInk (PR #11, branch feat/mark-ink-framing, commits 3f3db55 feature + baseline pin to 0.5.0). Exact post-solve per-side widening so point ink (radius+stroke+miter) sits a pt clearance inside the panel; identical scene when marks already fit; coordFixed exact via frame/solve fixed point; zoom and explicit layouts untouched; facets pool shared axes, free axes per panel; points only. Evidence: PanelFramingSuite (JVM+JS, judged on drawn device scene: specimen clips under Data and clears exactly 2 pt under MarkInk at 640x220, 320x160, 192 and 300 ppi) + Java2D stroked-outline oracle over 180 cases; testAll 15 targets / 1462 tests green; check-docs clean; check-compatibility exit 0 at the new pin. Java2D renders critiqued: 640x220 Data clips both extreme points, MarkInk whole with 2 pt clearance, no axis/plot motion; 1280x440@192ppi whole; 640x360 unchanged. Open until merged and until the PLS Neuro consumer (bd-01M1XYE51VCHZRQS0NR3YQBBD4) adopts .framing(PanelFraming.markInk) and records its own screenshots.
